Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this time expression is redundant because both parts indicate time; use the concise narrative form. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住了在：住在，了 cannot be placed between the verb and the locative phrase; this describes a living situation rather than a completed action, so omit 了. [teacher rule: le_placement]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，actions presented as a daily routine take no 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孩子搬家，跟 expresses doing an action together, while 带着 shows that the mother takes the child with her when moving. [vocab list]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 搬了到：搬到了，place 了 after the directional/result complement, as in 搬到 + 了. [teacher rule: le_placement]
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，另一个 refers to one different city; 别的 can modify a noun, but 别一个 is not the standard form. [teacher rule: bieren]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母住在：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和母亲孟母住在，first mention should introduce the main character with both a name and a clear identity. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子才五岁：他才五岁，after 孟子 was named in the immediately preceding sentence, use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence. [rule: none]
9. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：删除，那个城市 refers to a specific city that has not been introduced, so its referent is unclear. [rule: ambiguous_reference]

items.reason: 古代和的时候都表示时间，按教师标准“古代的时候”重复，应说“在古代”。
住在某地表示居住状态，不能说“住了在”，应为“住在”。
“每天”表示日常习惯，按教师的体貌规则不应使用完成体“了”。
“跟孩子搬家”可以自然地表示母亲和孩子一起搬家，并非错误。
“了”应放在趋向补语“到”之后，所以应说“搬到了”。
“别一个城市”不合规范；“另一个城市”能正确表示另一座城市。
首次出现主角应作身份介绍，但所给改句以“住在”结束，句子不完整，不能直接使用。
“孩子”未明确指孟子；紧接着前句提到孟子后，用“他”可以清楚指代孟子。
前文没有引入任何城市，“那个城市”的所指不明，删除后句子仍完整。
